title: Wreck and Rivergate
author: Ansel Blackwood
blurb: Ansel Yarrow, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
